quests.title: A Creature at Heel
quests.intro: Out past the fence the haunts keep small company: a farm that remembers sporebeans, a shrine that likes glowfruit. Offer food, and something may follow you home. Nothing here asks you to fight.

steps.text: Make a companion: offer food at a haunt (see PETS, TO MEET).
steps.prompt: Open PETS, then TO MEET: each creature says where and with what.

reward.text: A little food for your new companion

quests.title: Wake the Hollow
quests.intro: Every region has a guardian asleep in a ring of stones. Beat one and the next tier of making opens. Bring tonics, a battle stew and a bark salve; step out of the marked ground when it winds up.

steps.text: Defeat any region guardian (see the GUARDIANS tab).
steps.prompt: Walk to a guardian arena, ring the bell, dodge the marked ground, then claim again after the fight.
